verdict.rationale: The ucp.dev governance page presents UCP as an industry protocol, listing co-developers such as Google, Etsy, Wayfair, Target, Walmart, Microsoft, Stripe and others. The spec, versioned releases and reference implementations are public in an open GitHub org. Shopify also advertises a Universal Cart for merchants "on or off Shopify" and Google Pay payment handlers. However, the evidence is vendor or consortium claims of co-development, not proof of live third-party implementations, and every runtime probe hit Shopify-operated endpoints. Missing for 10: concrete evidence of at least two non-Shopify parties shipping working UCP implementations, independent or hands-on corroboration of third-party interop, and a generally available cross-merchant cart rather than a waitlisted one.
